name: Kneaders Slow-Roasted Turkey on Country White or Sourdough
whyItWorks: Freshly roasted, tender white turkey breast carved in-house served on soft bakery country white or sourdough bread. Free of tough gristle, rough bran, or inflammatory seasonings.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order turkey on country white or sourdough bread. Skip raw red onions, tomatoes, lettuce, and bacon. Light mayo is fine.
